design_overview: A modern, patient-centric hospital appointment booking system designed for iOS and Android platforms. The interface prioritizes clarity, ease of navigation, and quick access to core functions: finding doctors, booking appointments, and managing schedules. The design uses a clean, medical-professional aesthetic with calming colors, clear visual hierarchy, and touch-optimized components. Navigation follows native mobile patterns with bottom tab navigation for primary flows and contextual top bars for secondary screens.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showing upcoming appointments, quick actions, and personalized health information

key_components.interaction: Tapping avatar navigates to Profile screen

key_components.name: Upcoming Appointment Card
key_components.styling: Elevated white card with rounded corners (16px), subtle shadow, displays doctor photo, name 'Dr. Michael Chen', specialty 'Cardiologist', date 'Tomorrow, 10:30 AM', with primary blue accent border on left
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Appointment Details screen

key_components.name: Quick Actions Section
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable row of 4 action cards with icons: 'Book Appointment', 'Find Doctor', 'Medical Records', 'Prescriptions'. Each card has light blue background, rounded corners, icon on top, label below

key_components.name: Recent Doctors List
key_components.styling: Section header 'Recent Doctors' with 'See All' link. List of 3 doctor cards showing circular profile photo, name, specialty, rating stars, and 'Book Again' button

key_components.name: Health Tips Card
key_components.styling: Light green background card with rounded corners, displays health tip icon, title 'Stay Hydrated', brief description, and 'Learn More' link
key_components.interaction: Tapping card opens health tips detail view

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar with white background, 4 tabs with icons and labels: Home (active - blue), Search, Appointments, Profile. Active tab has blue icon and text
key_components.interaction: Tapping each tab navigates to respective main screen

screens.user_flow: Entry point after login. Users can view upcoming appointments, access quick actions, or navigate to other main sections via bottom tabs

screens.name: Doctor Search
screens.purpose: Search and filter doctors by specialty, availability, location, and ratings

key_components.name: Search Header
key_components.styling: White background with back button on left, 'Find a Doctor' title centered, filter icon on right
key_components.interaction: Back button returns to Home. Filter icon opens filter modal

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: Large rounded search bar with light gray background, search icon on left, placeholder 'Search by name, specialty...'
key_components.interaction: Typing filters doctor list in real-time

key_components.name: Specialty Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable row of specialty chips: 'All', 'Cardiology', 'Pediatrics', 'Dermatology', 'Orthopedics'. Selected chip has blue background, others have light gray
key_components.interaction: Tapping chip filters doctor list by specialty

key_components.name: Sort Dropdown
key_components.styling: Small button with text 'Sort by: Rating' and down arrow icon, light border
key_components.interaction: Opens dropdown menu with sort options: Rating, Experience, Availability, Fee

key_components.name: Doctor Results List
key_components.styling: Scrollable list of doctor cards. Each card shows circular profile photo, name, specialty, experience years, rating with stars, consultation fee, 'Available Today' badge if applicable, and 'View Profile' button
key_components.interaction: Tapping card or button navigates to Doctor Profile screen

key_components.name: No Results State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with text 'No doctors found' and 'Try adjusting your filters' subtitle. Shown when search returns empty
key_components.interaction: Static informational component

key_components.name: Filter Modal
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet modal with white background, rounded top corners. Contains sections: Specialty (checkboxes), Availability (date picker), Experience (slider), Fee Range (slider), Gender preference. 'Apply Filters' primary button at bottom
key_components.interaction: Selecting options and tapping Apply updates doctor list. Close button dismisses modal

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, Search tab active (blue icon and text)
key_components.interaction: Tapping tabs navigates to respective screens

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Home quick actions or bottom nav. Users search/filter doctors, view results, then tap to see doctor profile or book appointment

screens.name: Doctor Profile
screens.purpose: Display detailed doctor information, specialties, availability, reviews, and booking option

key_components.name: Profile Header
key_components.styling: White background with back button on left, bookmark icon on right. Large circular doctor photo centered below, name 'Dr. Michael Chen', specialty 'Cardiologist', rating '4.8 (127 reviews)'
key_components.interaction: Back button returns to search. Bookmark icon saves doctor to favorites

key_components.name: Quick Info Cards
key_components.styling: Three small cards in a row: '12 Years Experience', '$80 Consultation', 'Available Today'. Light blue background, rounded corners
key_components.interaction: Static informational display

key_components.name: About Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'About' header, bio text describing doctor's background, qualifications, and approach. 'Read More' link if text is long
key_components.interaction: 'Read More' expands full bio text

key_components.name: Specialties Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'Specialties' header, list of specialty tags with light blue background: 'Cardiology', 'Heart Surgery', 'Preventive Care'
key_components.interaction: Static informational display

key_components.name: Reviews Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'Patient Reviews' header and 'See All' link. Shows 2-3 review cards with patient name, rating stars, date, and review text
key_components.interaction: 'See All' navigates to full reviews screen. Individual reviews are static

key_components.name: Available Time Slots
key_components.styling: White card with 'Available Slots' header, date selector showing next 7 days, grid of time slot buttons (e.g., '9:00 AM', '10:30 AM'). Available slots have light blue background, booked slots are gray and disabled
key_components.interaction: Selecting date updates time slots. Tapping available slot selects it for booking

key_components.name: Book Appointment Button
key_components.styling: Large primary blue button with white text 'Book Appointment', fixed at bottom with shadow, rounded corners
key_components.interaction: Navigates to Appointment Booking Confirmation screen with selected time slot

key_components.name: Share Button
key_components.styling: Small secondary button with border, 'Share Profile' text and share icon, positioned next to Book button
key_components.interaction: Opens native share sheet to share doctor profile

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Doctor Search results. Users review doctor details, check availability, select time slot, then proceed to book appointment

screens.name: Appointment Booking Confirmation

key_components.name: Confirmation Header
key_components.styling: White background with back button on left, 'Confirm Appointment' title centered
key_components.interaction: Back button returns to Doctor Profile

key_components.name: Doctor Summary Card
key_components.styling: White card with doctor photo, name 'Dr. Michael Chen', specialty, selected date 'Tomorrow, March 15', selected time '10:30 AM', consultation fee '$80'
key_components.interaction: Static summary display

key_components.name: Reason for Visit Input
key_components.styling: Multi-line text input with light gray background, rounded corners, placeholder 'Describe your symptoms or reason for visit...'
key_components.interaction: User types reason for appointment

key_components.name: Patient Information Card
key_components.styling: White card showing patient name, age, contact number with 'Edit' link on right
key_components.interaction: 'Edit' link navigates to profile editing

key_components.name: Notification Preferences
key_components.styling: White card with checkboxes for 'Email reminder' and 'SMS reminder', both checked by default
key_components.interaction: Toggling checkboxes enables/disables notification channels

key_components.name: Terms Checkbox
key_components.styling: Checkbox with text 'I agree to the cancellation policy and terms of service' with linked text
key_components.interaction: Must be checked to enable Confirm button. Links open policy modals

key_components.name: Confirm Booking Button
key_components.styling: Large primary blue button with white text 'Confirm Booking', fixed at bottom, disabled state (gray) until terms accepted
key_components.interaction: Creates appointment and navigates to Booking Success screen

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: Text button 'Cancel' in gray, positioned above Confirm button
key_components.interaction: Returns to Doctor Profile without booking

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Doctor Profile after selecting time slot. Users review details, add visit reason, confirm notifications, accept terms, then confirm booking

screens.name: My Appointments
screens.purpose: View and manage all patient appointments (upcoming, past, cancelled)

key_components.name: Appointments Header
key_components.styling: White background with 'My Appointments' title centered, filter icon on right
key_components.interaction: Filter icon opens status filter options

key_components.name: Status Tabs
key_components.styling: Three tabs: 'Upcoming', 'Past', 'Cancelled'. Active tab has blue underline and text, others are gray
key_components.interaction: Tapping tab filters appointment list by status

key_components.name: Upcoming Appointments List
key_components.styling: Scrollable list of appointment cards. Each card shows doctor photo, name, specialty, date, time, status badge ('Confirmed' in green), and two action buttons: 'Reschedule' (secondary) and 'Cancel' (text, red)
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Appointment Details. 'Reschedule' opens time slot selector. 'Cancel' opens cancellation confirmation modal

key_components.name: Past Appointments List
key_components.styling: Similar card layout showing completed appointments with 'Completed' status badge in gray, 'Book Again' button, and 'Leave Review' link
key_components.interaction: Tapping card shows appointment details. 'Book Again' navigates to doctor profile. 'Leave Review' opens review modal

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with text 'No appointments yet' and 'Book your first appointment' subtitle with 'Find Doctor' button
key_components.interaction: 'Find Doctor' button navigates to Doctor Search

key_components.name: Cancellation Modal
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet modal with 'Cancel Appointment' title, warning text about cancellation policy, reason dropdown, optional notes input, 'Confirm Cancellation' button (red) and 'Keep Appointment' button (secondary)
key_components.interaction: 'Confirm' cancels appointment and updates list. 'Keep' dismisses modal

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, Appointments tab active (blue icon and text)
key_components.interaction: Tapping tabs navigates to respective screens

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom navigation. Users view appointment lists by status, manage upcoming appointments (reschedule/cancel), or book again from past appointments

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. Components use flexible layouts with percentage-based widths and minimum touch targets of 44x44px. Cards and lists adapt to screen width with consistent 16px horizontal margins. Typography scales proportionally. Tablet layouts (768px+) use two-column layouts where appropriate, with navigation shifting to side panel.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for text. All images include alt text. Form inputs have associated labels. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Error messages are descriptive and associated with form fields. Support for dynamic text sizing up to 200%.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use native slide animations (300ms). Button presses show subtle scale feedback (0.95 scale, 100ms). Cards have gentle elevation change on press. Bottom sheets slide up with spring animation. Loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect. Success actions show brief checkmark animation. All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style from standard icon libraries (Feather Icons or SF Symbols). Icons are 24px by default, 20px for small contexts. All icons are single-color, matching text color or using primary blue for active states. Icons always paired with labels for clarity except in bottom navigation where context is clear.
